name: Journey to Tarren Mill
statusNote: Unchanged in Forever as far as is known: the text, objectives and rewards below are Classic’s.
footerSourceNote: Text, givers, objectives and rewards come from the cMaNGOS Classic database (a reconstruction of the 1.12 world), with what Forever changed on top: the game server’s own answers where we have them, else Wowhead’s Forever database. narrative.details:
To rid Stonetalon of the Venture Company, we must take extreme measures.  Extreme, but without bloodshed.

A colleague of mine may have just the tool we need.  His name is Lydon; he dwells in the town of Tarren Mill in the Hillsbrad Foothills, in the distant land of Lordaeron.

To reach Hillsbrad, travel by zeppelin to our capital, the Undercity.  Then go north to Tirisfal Glades, southwest to Silverpine, and south to Hillsbrad.

Seek Lydon and bring him this note.  It details our needs to him.
narrative.objectives: Bring Zamah's Note to Apothecary Lydon in Tarren Mill.
narrative.offerRewardText:
A note from Zamah? Her needs must be great to send word from so far. Let us see what she says...

Ah, splendid! I know exactly what to do!
narrative.requestItemsText: Ah, are you here with my new test subjects?

chain.subtitle: 7 quests from level 18 to 23, 9,365 XP in all.

quests.name: Goblin Invaders
quests.objectiveText: Kill 15 Venture Co. Loggers, then return to Seereth Stonebreak on the border of Stonetalon and the Barrens.

quests.name: The Elder Crone
quests.objectiveText: Speak with Magatha in Thunder Bluff.

quests.name: Forsaken Aid
quests.objectiveText: Speak with Apothecary Zamah in the Pools of Vision in Thunder Bluff.

quests.name: Journey to Tarren Mill
quests.objectiveText: Bring Zamah's Note to Apothecary Lydon in Tarren Mill.

quests.name: Blood of Innocents
quests.objectiveText: Bring 5 Vials of Innocent Blood to Apothecary Lydon in Tarren Mill.

quests.name: Return to Thunder Bluff
quests.objectiveText: Bring Lydon's Toxin to Apothecary Zamah in Thunder Bluff.

quests.name: The Flying Machine Airport
quests.objectiveText: Bring the Toxic Fogger to the Venture Co.
